corrections.why: The register and Firelookout.com both say the 1931 stone and shake cabin is still there. The 'gone' status fits only the L-4 cab.

corrections.proposed: 14x14 ft stone and shake cabin (1931); L-4 cab gone
corrections.why: The L-4 was the gabled cab that was abandoned in 1953 and is gone. The structure still standing is the 14x14 ft stone and shake cabin.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Firelookout.com put the 1953 abandonment on the L-4 cab, which is gone. A 2014 blog puts it on the 1931 stone cabin, which it says is still there. The sources disagree on which structure the date applies to.
The register gives 8,046 ft (2,452 m), which matches the record's 2452.4 m. Firelookout.com gives 7,460 ft, and the blog estimates the top at about 8,074 ft.

notes_for_editor: Record says status gone, design L-4, kind ground. The register and Firelookout.com both say the 1931 stone and shake cabin is still there, so status and design were corrected. Kind 'ground' was left as is. The 1953 abandonment conflict is real: the two lookout sites tie it to the gone L-4 cab, and a single 2014 personal blog ties it to the standing cabin. Access and the 6.3-mile route rest on that one blog, so check current trail and trailhead status. The early-1930s L-4 date has no exact year, so it is not an event. The record's note that Holland Ridge shares a register number is not borne out here: the register lists US 1494, MT 72, and Coal Ridge is US 1498. No photos added.
